scope: Exact evidence values and per-item correlation for the six current REST scenarios
decimalParsing: Decimal from JSON tokens; no intermediate binary float
valueComparison: Boolean, number, string and null are distinct; equal numeric spellings are equivalent
recordComparison: Top-level record order is ignored; multiplicity and nested array order are preserved
reject: duplicate JSON keys or nonfinite numbers
unknown case, item, role, schema or data profile
missing, duplicate, mixed-run or misordered evidence
different values, types or record counts between preparation, response and processing
automatic failure, stop or not-run promoted to success
implementationChoice: The evidence adapter format and comparisons are project implementation rules, not additional normative test items
